messages:
alice-support: FYI ticket #78941 — customer says their trial credits didn't decrement after a successful streaming chat. response shows tokens used in body but their org wallet total is unchanged. attaching snippet from customer: 

alice-support: “response: {
  "usage": { "prompt_tokens": 120, "completion_tokens": 45, "total_tokens": 165 },
  "status": 200
}
wallet: 500 credits before and after”

alice-support: Can someone take a quick look? Customer is on trial org id: org_gh-501. They can repro with the js-sdk streaming endpoint. :thinking:

jake-sre: Jumping in. First quick questions: 1) Are they using the SDK auto-finalize or manually calling finalize? 2) Any retries visible from their client?

alice-support: Customer says they rely on SDK auto finalize. No explicit finalize call. No obvious client retries, they reported a single successful stream and then closed the socket.

maya-billing: I pulled ledger for org_gh-501. I see an entry for the session with request_id=rid_0a9 showing a consumption record in ledger.status = "pending_finalize" at 2026-03-05T14:11:20Z, amount=165 tokens. No corresponding finalized debit. Hmm.

billing-bot: [ledger-event] session_opened request_id=rid_0a9, session_closed request_id=rid_0a9, consumption_record created id=cr_992 status=pending_finalize

liam-eng: Possible causes: (a) finalize webhook failed to deliver to billing service, (b) reconcile worker errored on idempotence key, or (c) streaming client never sent end-of-stream event so auto-finalize timed out but didn't trigger finalize. Do we have the stream logs?

jake-sre: I asked customer for a HAR and the SDK debug logs. In the meantime I can tail the finalize queue for their request_id and see if it errored.

billing-bot: [worker-alert] finalize-queue: attempt=3 request_id=rid_0a9 -> retry_backoff, last_error=HTTP 502 to billing-service /finalize endpoint at 14:12:05Z

maya-billing: That explains it — billing-service returned 502 during the finalize attempt and our worker retried but gave up after backoff. Worker left record in pending_finalize. We should have fallback reconciliation to pick these up — looks like reconcile job skipped org_gh-501 due to a tagging bug in last deploy.

liam-eng: Ugh, there's an open PR that added a filter on reconcile targets. It accidentally excluded orgs missing the new tag. I will revert the filter and re-run reconcile.

jake-sre: Actionable repro for eng: customer can run a single streaming request that ends without an explicit finalize and then our finalize worker should call billing-service. If billing-service returns 502, the consumption stays pending and reconcile should later finalize it.

liam-eng: Reverted filter and kicked reconcile for a 24h window covering the customer's session. I also patched the worker to increase retries from 3 -> 6 with exponential backoff and to emit a monitoring alert on >2 consecutive finalize failures for same org.

maya-billing: I manually finalized cr_992 to clear the customer's balance; applied -165 tokens and updated wallet total. Sent customer a confirmation email.

alice-support: Thanks team. I replied to customer summarizing: root cause = finalize webhook failures + reconcile exclusion; fix = revert filter + manual finalize + worker retry bump + alerting. Customer accepts credit correction. :white_check_mark:

jake-sre: Follow-ups: 1) postmortem to eng/reconcile owner, 2) add synthetic test that simulates billing-service 5xx during finalize, 3) ensure billing dashboards show pending_finalize backlog by org.

liam-eng: Agreed. I'll open the PRs and link to ticket #78941.

alice-support: tagging for visibility: @maya-billing @jake-sre @liam-eng — closing thread after PM posts postmortem summary.
